session.chatViewNote: Show live sessions as chat bubbles instead of raw terminal output. Beta — may be buggy and not always work.

permissions.cameraDesc: QR code scanning to pair with servers

crashReporting.title: Share anonymous crash reports
crashReporting.description: Send sanitized technical crash information to help improve Threadbase. Prompts, terminal output, source code, credentials, server addresses, and session content are never included.
crashReporting.testCrashConfirmMessage: This raises a test error so you can confirm reporting works. Only available in development builds.

sessionNaming.title: Session Naming
sessionNaming.autoNameNote: Set the session name from the first words of your first message. No AI, no tokens.
sessionNaming.aiGeneratedNote: Use an AI model to generate a meaningful name. Uses tokens from your configured API key.

language.restartMessage: Changing between RTL and LTR languages requires restarting the app to apply the layout changes.

notificationHealth.heading: Notification health
notificationHealth.subtitle: Per-server push registration state from the streamer. Tokens are never shown.
notificationHealth.emptyBody: Pair a server first, then check notification delivery health here.
notificationHealth.reregisterFailed: Re-registration failed. Check notification permission and try again.
notificationHealth.quietActive: Quiet hours are active now — alerts are suppressed locally.
notificationHealth.quietInactive: Quiet hours are off or not active right now.
notificationHealth.storeAvailable: Push store is available on this server.
notificationHealth.storeUnavailable: Push store is unavailable on this server (registration cannot persist).
notificationHealth.noTokens: No push tokens registered for this server yet.
notificationHealth.hintNeverDelivered: Registered, but no successful delivery yet (detection vs delivery).
notificationHealth.hintDelivery: Delivery failures are accumulating on the server — re-register or check Expo credentials.
notificationHealth.hintRevoked: This token was revoked on the server.
